questions.stem: What is the relative charge of a neutron?
questions.explanation: Neutrons have a relative charge of 0 (no charge). They are found in the nucleus alongside protons (+1 charge). Electrons have a relative charge of -1.

questions.stem: Why is an atom electrically neutral?

options.text: Because it contains neutrons which cancel out all charges
Because it has equal numbers of protons and electrons
Because the nucleus has no overall charge

questions.explanation: In a neutral atom, the number of protons (each with +1 charge) equals the number of electrons (each with -1 charge). These charges cancel out, making the atom electrically neutral overall.
